scope: AI writing/drafting tools or materially new product releases published from 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-31, prioritizing legal and high-stakes enterprise writing
verification_rule: Each accepted item uses a vendor-controlled official URL, a publication/release date inside the requested window, a unique vendor/tool identity, and an explicit writing/drafting or drafting-enabling capability. Availability wording is kept as stated by the vendor; no free-access claim is inferred.

items.specialization: legal AI agents with matter/project context, institutional templates, memory of user style and legal-specific reasoning
writing_capabilities: drafts can inherit firm or in-house templates, headings, numbering, defined terms and citation style
agents use prior matter context and user preferences so substantive legal work does not restart from a blank prompt
items.evidence_note: Official Harvey product announcement dated 2026-08-18 states that Harvey II agents inherit matter context and memory and can work from firm templates so drafts arrive in the team's established shape.

items.specialization: high-stakes legal research, analysis, drafting and redlining grounded in Westlaw, Practical Law and firm precedents
writing_capabilities: creates a legal work plan, retrieves authority and precedents, then drafts with citations
supports transactional redlining and agentic brief/motion drafting with attorney review
items.access: early access for U.S. CoCounsel Legal customers from the week of 2026-06-22; vendor product access
items.evidence_note: Official Thomson Reuters announcement says every U.S. CoCounsel Legal customer receives the next-generation toggle during the launch week and describes drafting with citations and redlining.

items.tool_name: Lexis+ with Protégé for In-House Legal and Compliance
items.specialization: purpose-built legal and compliance AI for in-house teams, using authoritative LexisNexis content and enterprise context
writing_capabilities: supports professional legal work that moves from authoritative research and analysis into drafting
targets day-to-day in-house legal and compliance workflows rather than general consumer writing
items.evidence_note: Official LexisNexis PressRoom release dated 2026-07-08 explicitly calls the offering purpose-built AI for in-house legal and compliance teams.

items.specialization: 100+ attorney-built, legally structured multi-step workflows across contracts, compliance, M&A, litigation and other practice areas
writing_capabilities: includes drafting/redlining clause workflows, negotiation-ready counterproposals and legal work product generation
workflows can incorporate team preferences, matter history, supporting files and internal standards
items.access: existing LegalOn customers; prospective customers can request a demo or trial
items.evidence_note: Official LegalOn release dated 2026-07-28 states that Prompt Workflows are available now and that LegalOn Assistant can draft; the release describes attorney-built workflows aimed at finished legal work product.

items.specialization: proprietary vertical legal model trained for the structure, language and commercial reality of contracts
writing_capabilities: powers Legal-Grade agentic workflows across contract review, negotiation and related drafting actions
specialist contract-language understanding is used to identify obligations, non-standard clauses and legal/commercial consequences
items.evidence_note: Official Luminance announcement dated 2026-06-19 says Luna Crescent is purpose-built for contract work and already embedded across contract intelligence features.

items.specialization: in-house legal drafting and redlining directly beside the AI chat in a Word-compatible document workflow
writing_capabilities: revises existing contract language as tracked redlines
drafts new clauses or schedules and exports native Word tracked changes/comments
items.access: generally available to GC AI customers at launch; vendor trial/demo options
items.evidence_note: Official GC AI launch post dated 2026-07-30 states Easy Edit is generally available and can revise clauses, draft new language and preserve tracked changes.

items.tool_name: Wordsmith for Payments — Three Legal AI Agents
items.specialization: legal AI agents for payment-industry contracts, sponsor-bank obligations and scheme-rule changes
writing_capabilities: agents read, check and draft payment-sector legal work with human sign-off
drafts attestations, policy updates, contract wording and merchant notices tied to applicable rules
items.evidence_note: Official Wordsmith PRODUCT post dated 2026-07-09 says the three agents each read, check and draft, including contract wording, notices, attestations and policy updates.

items.specialization: chat-native legal AI for contract review, redlining and legal-document generation
writing_capabilities: drafts contracts from scratch through an approval-first outline and document-editor workflow
can generate contracts, memos, pleadings and other legal documents and revise drafts conversationally
items.evidence_note: Official goHeather August 2026 update dated 2026-08-25 states Version 3 is here, makes the product chat-native and adds contract drafting from scratch.

items.specialization: AI-powered legal knowledge retrieval inside Microsoft Word for precedent- and clause-based drafting
writing_capabilities: surfaces firm precedents and clauses with context-aware recommendations
supports rapid contract creation by inserting gold-standard precedent language directly into the draft
items.evidence_note: Official Definely launch post dated August 13, 2026 describes Vault as an AI-powered legal knowledge solution and explicitly lists rapid contract creation from trusted precedents.

items.specialization: enterprise AI writing/workflow playbooks with reusable drafting, review, voice, testing and bulk execution controls
writing_capabilities: chains research, briefing, drafting, review and publishing steps into reusable workflows
supports per-step voice/instructions, output testing and bulk runs for consistent enterprise writing
items.access: WRITER customer playbooks; upgraded experience rolled out from 2026-07-13 with migration in July/August
items.evidence_note: Official WRITER announcement dated 2026-07-13 describes the upgraded Playbooks rollout, including drafting/review chains, voice profiles, testing and bulk execution.

rejected_or_deferred_examples.name: Legora + Avvoka first-draft integration
rejected_or_deferred_examples.reason: Official 2026-08-24 announcement says beta availability is planned for Q4 2026, so it was excluded from the ten immediately usable/available-or-active releases.

rejected_or_deferred_examples.name: Litera connected contract drafting and negotiation workflow
rejected_or_deferred_examples.reason: Official 2026-08-18 announcement describes an ILTACON preview; general availability is not stated in the launch page, so it was excluded from the strict ten.

rejected_or_deferred_examples.name: Draftwise Legal Ontology
rejected_or_deferred_examples.reason: The 2026-08-24 launch is a powerful proprietary-intelligence layer for legal knowledge, but the launch itself is less directly a writing/drafting release than the accepted ten.
